annotations.text: "Operational precision" — Linear x trading terminal. Near-black ground + grain, one electric-lime accent, Hanken Grotesk (prose) + IBM Plex Mono (numbers, labels, status tags). Two-column: scrollable queue left, sticky detail right; header spans both.
Below ~1024px the two columns stack; the queue becomes a card list (name + StatusBadge, company, mini ScoreMeter). No fake status bar.
